help.title: Help & User Guide
help.faq_q1: How do I convert a Word file to Markdown?
help.faq_a1: Go to File tab → Open Document, select your .docx file. The app auto-detects the format. Choose 'Word → MD' mode in the ribbon, set an output path, then click Convert Now.
help.faq_q2: Why is my PDF conversion blank?
help.faq_a2: PDF export requires WeasyPrint or ReportLab. Run 'pip install weasyprint' in your environment and restart the app. A dependency warning will appear in the footer if they are missing.
help.faq_q3: Can I edit the Markdown directly in the app?
help.faq_a3: Yes — the Editor panel is fully editable. Use the Edit tab in the ribbon for formatting shortcuts like Heading H1–H6, Bold, Italic, and Code blocks.
help.faq_q4: Where are my auto-saved drafts stored?
help.faq_a4: Drafts are saved to %APPDATA%\DocConvert\draft_autosave.md and restored automatically when you reopen the app.
help.faq_q5: How do I change the color theme?
help.faq_a5: Use the Settings tab in the ribbon. You can choose from 4 palettes (Violet Cyberpunk, Emerald Obsidian, Deep Ocean, Sunset Gold) and switch between Dark, Light, or System mode.
help.step1_desc: Click 'Open Document' in the File tab or press Ctrl+O. Supported formats: .md, .docx, .xlsx, .csv, .pdf, .html
help.step2_desc: Select your target format from the mode dropdown (e.g. 'Word → MD'). The mode is automatically suggested based on the file you opened.
help.step3_desc: The output path is pre-filled automatically. You can browse to a custom location using 'Save Destination' in the File tab.
help.step4_desc: Click the 'CONVERT NOW' button in the action bar at the bottom. A progress bar shows conversion status.
help.step5_desc: Once complete, use the 'Open File' or 'Open Folder' buttons to access your output. The converted file can be found at the path shown in the status bar.
